row:
PRO+ Sports Medicine Education is a practical learning platform for physical therapists, athletic trainers, students, strength coaches, and sports medicine professionals.

Led by orthopedic and sports clinical specialist, Dr. Russell Linville, DPT, this channel provides high-yield education on:

• Orthopedic special tests
• Anatomy and palpation
• Sports rehabilitation
• Return-to-sport testing
• Exercise prescription
• Manual therapy
• Throwing athlete rehab
• Clinical reasoning

Our goal is simple: help clinicians evaluate better, treat smarter, and build confidence in orthopedic and sports physical therapy.

Subscribe for evidence-based sports medicine education, rehab demonstrations, clinical assessments, and practical tools you can use immediately in the clinic.

Learn more at pro-plus.co
